text:
alex: Quick heads-up — we plan to run the tenant metadata migration + index backfill tonight at 00:35 UTC. Deploybot will start the job; this will take ~20-30m. Need a soft-pause/quiesce on writes for affected tenants. Plan: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/tenant-migration-2026
maria: Thanks. Which tenants and how are we throttling? Any shard-by-shard order? :thinking_face:
alex: Tenants: group A (primary shards 3,7,11). Throttle via deploybot config — concurrency 4, ratecap 100 rows/s per shard. We'll do shard order 7 -> 3 -> 11 (low traffic first).
samir: Copy. Can we pin the release during the window so no hotfixes land? I can set a gate on the deploy pipeline.
alex: Yes please pin release tag v2.14.7 for the next 2 hours starting at 00:20 UTC. If we need to push a hotfix, we have the rollback playbook.
liz_oncall: I'll be on-call for the window. Set me a reminder 00:15 UTC. Also share the rollback escape hatch now so I can review:
maria: Escape hatch quick notes:
- stop deploybot job
- flip feature flag tenant_meta_migration -> off
- run backfill-rollback script to mark partial rows as pending
samir: Deploybot command preview (will run at start time):
```
deploybot start-job --job tenant-meta-backfill --concurrency 4 --ratecap 100 --order 7,3,11 --tag v2.14.7
```
alex: We're leaving a 10m preflight (00:25-00:35) to observe metrics and warm caches. If error rate > 0.5% or p95 latency > 450ms, we abort.
deploy-bot: [info] scheduled job tenant-meta-backfill to start at 00:35 UTC (initiated by alex). job_id=jb_20260323_01
maria: Double-checking: KV cache warmup is enabled? We should avoid cold starts for shard 7.
alex: Yep, warmup=true in the job config. Also enabling prefix KV cache for common queries.
liz_oncall: Reminder set. I'll watch the dashboard and post signal:ok or signal:abort in this thread.
samir: I'll pin v2.14.7 now and post the pin id here.
samir: Pin done — release_pin: rp-8812. Posted to release-notes channel.
maria: Quick SQL sanity we plan to run during preflight:
```
SELECT count(1) FROM tenant_meta WHERE needs_backfill = true AND shard_id = 7;
```
Expect ~1200 rows on shard 7.
alex: If everything looks green at preflight, we allow the job to continue. If shard 7 backfill has >5% errors, we pause and revert to ratecap 50.
deploy-bot: [update] job jb_20260323_01 preflight check scheduled for 00:25 UTC. preflight_checks: metrics, queries_per_second, error_rate
liz_oncall: preflight reminder: 00:25 UTC (05m)
maria: FYI I added a short smoke verifier that runs after each shard completes — it checks referential integrity for 100 random rows.
alex: Sweet. Post any verifier failures here. If verifier fails twice in a row, we abort and start the rollback steps.
deploy-bot: [status] preflight started (00:25 UTC). running checks...
deploy-bot: [status] preflight passed. metrics stable. proceeding to start shard 7 backfill at 00:35 UTC.
deploy-bot: [status] shard 7 backfill progress 10% (est 18m remaining)
maria: saw a few transient db timeouts around 00:41 — reducing concurrency to 3.
alex: Acknowledge. Samir, can you update the job? Command:
```
deploybot update-job --job jb_20260323_01 --concurrency 3
```
samir: Done.
deploy-bot: [update] concurrency updated to 3 for jb_20260323_01
deploy-bot: [status] shard 7 backfill progress 48% (est 9m remaining)
maria: smoke verifier ran for shard 7 — passed 100/100 checks. Good to continue.
liz_oncall: signal:ok — no customer impact seen.
deploy-bot: [status] shard 7 complete. starting shard 3 backfill.
deploy-bot: [status] shard 3 progress 5%
maria: verifier popped 2 integrity errors on shard 3 at 00:58.
alex: Detail please — are these schema mismatches or data anomalies?
maria: Two rows failed FK check to users table — likely due to eventual consistency with a late write. I'm re-running verifier sample and will open a ticket if it reproduces.
samir: Given verifier failures, we should throttle further: ratecap -> 50 and pause after shard 3 if errors persist.
alex: Agreed. Apply ratecap 50 now and pause on next shard switch if we see >1% failures.
samir: ratecap updated.
deploy-bot: [update] ratecap set to 50 rows/s for jb_20260323_01
maria: re-run of verifier sample now shows 0/100 failures. The two earlier were transient; possibly mid-flight write. I'll increase sample to 500 rows for next shard.
liz_oncall: I'm keeping watch. If integrity errors reappear, I'm prepared to flip flag and stop the job.
deploy-bot: [status] shard 3 complete. starting shard 11 backfill.
deploy-bot: [status] shard 11 progress 40%
alex: If shard 11 hits >30% of total runtime estimate, we start staged rollback (stop job, mark partial). This gives us an escape hatch without immediate user-visible regressions.
maria: shard 11 verifier currently 200/200 pass. running the extended sample next.
deploy-bot: [status] shard 11 complete. job jb_20260323_01 finished successfully at 01:02 UTC. total runtime 27m.
alex: Awesome — thanks everyone. Samir, unpin the release after a 30m observation window? We want to keep pin until 01:35 UTC.
samir: Will unpin at 01:35 and note the postmortem channel if any follow-ups needed.
liz_oncall: observation window started. so far no impact. signal:ok
maria: I'll draft a short post-mortem with timings and verifier logs. Posting to #eng-releases/postmortems tomorrow morning.
alex: Closing notes: keep rollback playbook handy and add the verifier logs to the runbook. Great job everyone. :tada:
